entities.summary: Ireland as the 'Island of Saints and Scholars'. Great monasteries at Clonmacnoise, Glendalough, and Iona. The illumination of the Book of Kells, Columba's mission to Scotland, and Irish monks spreading learning across Europe (peregrinatio).
